versions.notes: The h3 was initially flagged as a defect by comparing against the big-footer twig h4. Reading usa-footer/src/index.js showed toggleHtmlTag preserves any h1-h6 via data-tag, so the heading level is an authoring decision. Same lesson as file-input: check whether the element is functional before calling a difference a defect.

versions.notes: Class provenance policy applied. Spec now states that every class in a tile must be design-system, a design-system utility, declared demo scaffolding, or a custom class documented in limitations — a class with no direction is a defect. A corpus scan found 22 component-adjacent custom classes; four cases were undocumented and are fixed here. The remaining documented ones (logo-*, chart-legend, demo-legend-item) already carry limitations.
